images.alt: Campaign graphic titled “Green Party Policy 2026.” Large text reads: “Water is life. The Green Party will make sure our water is safe to drink, swim in, and fish from.” An arrow points right toward a group of people jumping from a jetty into the sea. The lower portion of the image shows blue ocean water; the background is light grey with green branding and the Green Party logo.

Campaign graphic titled “Green Party Policy 2026.” Large text reads: “Aotearoa is a water-rich country.” Smaller text states that the Luxon Government is weakening environmental protections to benefit industrial agriculture and fishing. The image features blue ocean water, a fish above the waves, and people standing on a jetty at the lower left. Green Party branding appears at the top.

Green Party Policy 2026 graphic titled “The Facts.” The graphic lists four statements: up to 100,000 people get sick from unsafe drinking water every year; nearly half of rivers are unsafe for swimming; three out of four lakes are unhealthy; and New Zealand is the only country still bottom trawling in the South Pacific. The text appears in dark green on a light background. Ocean waves span the bottom of the image, with a white sailboat on the right-hand side. Green Party branding appears at the top right.

Campaign graphic titled “Green Party Policy 2026.” Text reads: “Nature should come before corporate profits.” Additional text says the Green Party will prioritise the health of rivers, lakes and the moana, and ensure drinking water is safe. The graphic concludes with the phrase “Because water is for life.” Blue ocean waves span the bottom of the image, with part of a sailboat visible at the lower left and a Green Party logo at the lower right.

post.text:
The Green Party will fix the rules so all of us can drink, swim, and fish in the places we love 🐟💚

See our greens.org.nz for the full policy: www.greens.org.nz/waterforlife
